targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT sum(flagged) AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT (sum(flagged) / greatest(count(), 1)) * 100 AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT avg(amount) AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT sum(if(flagged = 1, amount, 0)) AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT avg(dateDiff('millisecond', kafka_received_at, scored_at)) AS value FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback
SELECT toStartOfSecond(scored_at) AS time, count() AS tx_count, sum(flagged) AS fraud_count FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfSecond(scored_at) AS time, avg(dateDiff('millisecond', kafka_received_at, scored_at)) AS latency FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT transaction_id, card_id, customer_id, amount, formatDateTime(scored_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS t, fraud_probability FROM (SELECT * FROM riskfabric.fraud_scores WHERE flagged = 1 AND scored_at >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY scored_at ASC LIMIT 50)
SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'roc_auc' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'pr_auc' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'precision_operational' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'precision_true' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'recall_operational' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'recall_true' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'psi' AND report_type = 'prediction_drift' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'join_rate' AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY report_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT report_time AS time, metric_name, metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE report_type = 'classification' AND metric_name IN ('roc_auc_operational', 'roc_auc_true', 'recall_operational', 'recall_true', 'pr_auc_operational', 'pr_auc_true') AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY time
SELECT report_time AS time, metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE report_type = 'prediction_drift' AND metric_name = 'psi' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY time

SELECT report_time AS time, metric_name, metric_value FROM riskfabric.monitoring_metrics WHERE metric_name IN ('actual_fraud_rate_operational', 'actual_fraud_rate_true', 'flagged_rate_operational') AND report_type = 'classification' AND report_time >= now() - INTERVAL $lookback ORDER BY time
